questions.title: Fair die result above four
questions.prompt: A fair six-sided die is rolled once. What is the probability that the result is greater than 4?

answer.explanation: The favorable results are 5 and 6, so two of the six equally likely results are favorable. Thus the probability is 2/6 = 1/3.

solutionSteps: Two of the six equally likely results, 5 and 6, satisfy the condition, so the probability is 2/6 = 1/3.
